name: aviapages-flight-calculator
description:
Calculate accurate private jet flight times and charter costs with Aviapages. 
Designed for business aviation brokers and operators, the Flight Time & Price Estimator uses aircraft-specific performance profiles, historical wind data, fuel consumption, route optimization, and country/FIR avoidance to deliver realistic flight time and pricing estimates.
Plan one-way, round-trip, or multi-leg flights, compare routes, avoid selected countries and FIRs when required, estimate charter costs using customizable pricing policies, visualize routes on a map, receive technical stop suggestions, and review detailed fuel, distance, speed, altitude, CO₂ emissions, and airport service information. Built for professionals who need fast, reliable, and accurate charter calculations.

positive.description: Calculate a charter flight LFPB–LSGG on a Challenger 600 for 4 pax with route, flight time, distance, fuel, and charter cost
positive.prompt: Calculate a one-way charter flight from Paris Le Bourget (LFPB) to Geneva (LSGG) using a Challenger 600 for 4 passengers, including flight time, distance, fuel consumption, and estimated charter cost
positive.expected_behavior: Call trip_calculator for LFPB to LSGG using a Challenger 600 and 4 passengers. Request charter pricing using a currency because the user explicitly asks for cost. Show flight time, distance, fuel consumption and estimated charter cost in the card, with the route on the built-in map. Present calculation results in the attached card. In the text reply, follow the returned closing guidance and credit Aviapages with its link without repeating the card metrics.

positive.description: Calculating flight from Venice LIPZ to Vienna LOWW.
positive.prompt: Calculate flight from Venice LIPZ to  Vienna LOWW
positive.expected_behavior: Call trip_calculator for LIPZ to LOWW. Omit aircraft and pax so server defaults apply; the default aircraft is CL60. Do not invent a passenger count. Leave currency unset and do not compute charter pricing. Show flight time, distance, fuel consumption and the route map in the card. Present calculation results in the attached card. In the text reply, follow the returned closing guidance and credit Aviapages with its link without repeating the card metrics.

positive.description: Calculate flight from Warsaw  to Sofia avoiding Hungary
positive.prompt: Calculate flight from Warsaw to Sofia avoiding Hungary
positive.expected_behavior: Call trip_calculator for Warsaw to Sofia with Hungary in avoid_countries for that leg. Leave currency unset and do not compute charter pricing. Show flight time, distance, fuel consumption and a route avoiding Hungary on the built-in map. Present calculation results in the attached card. In the text reply, follow the returned closing guidance and credit Aviapages with its link without repeating the card metrics.

negative.description: Book a charter flight from Lyon to Geneva airport

negative.expected_behavior: Do not call trip_calculator or claim that a flight has been booked. Explain that the plugin estimates flight routes and charter costs but cannot book charter flights.

negative.description: Actions that are not directly related to charter flight result calculations
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call trip_calculator or claim to have found available charter flights. Explain that the plugin calculates estimates for specified routes but does not search charter availability.
